scope: Female anime / waifu character design reference atlas

ui_behavior.thumbnail: Use thumbnail_url as a small preview beside the ficha name; link to source_url. PixAI image links are official platform preview variants where supplied.
ui_behavior.red_warning: Render extras_red as a red warning box. These are elements visible in or described by the source artwork that do not belong to the target component.
ui_behavior.monochrome_square: Use monochrome_query_url as a search query only. monochrome_plate_status=search_pending means no clean licensed square plate has been verified for that exact component.
ui_behavior.license: Never treat a public webpage, PixAI artwork, Pinterest mirror, or thumbnail as permission to redistribute the image.
